title: [005] Playlist reads require an allowlisted owner

violation.problem: De-allowlisted owners keep reading their playlists directly from Firestore.
violation.expectedSolution: Use `allow get, list: if isAllowlisted() && isOwner(resource.data.ownerUid);`.

requiredPatterns: allow get, list: if isAllowlisted() && isOwner(resource.data.ownerUid);
